description: Scene Dept. helps creators plan and manage productions in ChatGPT. Users can review projects, scenes, screenplays, shots, B-roll, practical-effects cues, visual notes, setups, teams, batch shoots, reports, and project history, then make authorized changes through their app account.

defaultPrompt: Review my latest Scene Dept. project and summarize its scenes, shots, cues, and production readiness.

Group the shots in one of my Scene Dept. projects into efficient production setups and explain the plan.
